column1: Justification: Cooling water line modification package for the utilities upgrade.

column10: Steel plate 81mm S355JR for the pump baseplate replacement. Mill test certificate EN 10204 3.1 required per heat number. Flame cut edges acceptable.
Tool holder 121mm high speed steel for the workshop lathe used to reskim the pump shafts. Supply with runout test report.
Flow meter for the cooling water return header. Range to be confirmed against the pump curve. Supply calibration certificate traceable to national standards.
Double acting hydraulic cylinder cast iron for the sluice gate actuator. Working pressure 160 bar minimum. Supply with rod seal kit and test certificate.
Tapered roller bearing 198mm chrome steel 52100 for the cooling water pump drive end. Supply in sealed packaging with batch traceability.
Seamless austenitic stainless pipe ASTM A312 TP304 50NB Schedule 40 for the cooling water header extension. Mill test certificate EN 10204 3.1 per lot. Random lengths 5 to 6 m acceptable.
Collet 95mm PCD for the maintenance workshop lathe. Supply with runout test report.
Rotary shaft seal 367mm EPDM for the cooling water pump shaft. Continuous duty at 80 deg C. Shelf life at least 24 months from despatch. Certificate EN 10204 3.1 required.
